visual.general_description: Chart with six antibiotic bars above a line graph of hemoglobin (g/dL) against day after admission, with arrows for 2 units RBC and IVIG for 5 days.
visual.detailed_description: A white image with two stacked parts. The upper part lists six drug names on the left, each with a thick black horizontal bar to its right: Vancomycin has a short bar at the far left and, after a gap, a long bar that ends before the middle of the plot; Daptomycin has a short bar that fills the gap between the two Vancomycin bars; Cefepime and Metronidazole each have a short bar starting at the left; Ceftaroline has a long bar starting near the end of the long Vancomycin bar and running nearly to the right edge; Linezolid has a short thick arrow at the far right pointing right, past the end of the axis. The lower part is a line graph with a bold y-axis title "Hemoglobin g/dL", y ticks 0 to 14 in steps of 2 with light gray horizontal gridlines, and a bold x-axis title "Day after admission" with ticks labelled 0 to 25, 27 to 31 and 33. The black line starts at about 12 to 13 g/dL on day 0, stays between about 10.6 and 12 through day 9 with small dips near days 6 and 8, falls steeply to about 5.5 on day 11, stays between about 4.5 and 6 until day 15 where it reaches its lowest point near 4, then rises gradually with small dips to about 8 to 9 near days 25 to 33, ending at about 8.7. A downward arrow near the day 14 tick has the text "IVIG for 5 days" above it, and an upward arrow near the day 13 tick has the text "2 units RBC" below it. No patient names, identification numbers, dates or photographs are visible.

pixel_observations: Six antibiotic rows labelled Vancomycin, Daptomycin, Cefepime, Metronidazole, Ceftaroline and Linezolid, each with a thick black bar or arrow; Vancomycin has two bars separated by a gap that Daptomycin fills.
Ceftaroline bar begins just before the day 13 tick and runs to about day 33; the Linezolid arrow starts at the far right end of the axis, just past the day 33 label, and points right.
The second Vancomycin bar starts near day 4 to 5 and ends near day 12; the Cefepime and Metronidazole bars span roughly days 0 to 3.
Y-axis "Hemoglobin g/dL" with ticks 0 to 14 in steps of 2; x-axis "Day after admission" with tick labels 0 to 25, 27 to 31 and 33.
Hemoglobin line: about 12.8 at day 0, steep fall around days 10 to 11 to about 5.5, lowest near 4 at day 15, gradual rise to about 8 to 9 from day 25 to day 33.
Arrow labelled "IVIG for 5 days" near day 14 and arrow labelled "2 units RBC" near day 13.
No names, identification numbers, dates or faces are visible.
